lines.en: I swim wholly under the water.
My tail sweeps side to side to push.
My two horns steady me like a rudder.
I sweep over the tops of the weeds.
The current slides over my back.
I travel along the riverbed gravel.
One twist and I change direction.
Water drifts past my mouth.
I head for the deeper water.
There's no sound on the surface.
I glide a stretch along the mud.
My hide gleams under the light.
I swim past the sunken log.
I sink slowly deeper.
The light above grows fainter.
I hover still on the bottom.
The horn tips almost touch the mud.
I hold my mouth open for food.
I hear footsteps on the bank.
This stretch of water is clear.
I close my mouth slowly.
The weeds sway near me.
My belly brushes the riverbed.
I haven't moved at all.
Light bends down through the surface.
A fish slips past me.
I angle my body slightly.
You're looking down from the bank.
I'm in the water beneath your feet.
You can't make out my outline.
My horns waver below the surface.
I watch your shadow from below.
A layer of water lies between us.
I give my tail one sweep.
Ripples spread outward in rings.
You crouch for a better look.
I tumbled over in the water.
My tail got caught.
Mud billowed up.
I dived down quickly.
A little red spreads in the water.
I held still a moment before moving.
There's a scratch on my body.
The water pushed me off course.
The water takes some of the sting.
That thing is sinking down.
It's sinking straight down.
Not alive — I won't eat it.
The current carried it off course.
I slowly opened my mouth.
Too big to bite into.
It bumped into my horns.
I push it back toward the shallows.
I can't make out its shape down here.
You got in the water and hit me.
I slid away at once.
It's easy to evade in water.
Your knee met my horn.
The water's churned opaque.
I've gone behind your legs.
All you grabbed was water.
I slipped off into the deep water.
My hide is far too slick.
You've climbed back out again.
There are only the two of us down here.
You swim a little faster than I do.
Our horns are nearly identical.
Let's swim along the riverbed together.
Never mind the world above.
I follow the wake you leave.
We're quiet, pressed close.
Go deeper and I'll follow.
We don't often surface.
Let's just keep swimming slowly.
Something bright lies on the bottom.
I lift it on my horns.
It slipped away from my mouth.
A piece of sunken wood.
I push it onto the mud.
Your thing sank very fast.
I bit at it and missed.
Weeds are tangled around it.

lines.zh: 水里用头鳍，我用头顶着。
lines.en: Underwater I use my head fins to nudge it.
You've come all the way into the water.
Your shape is sinking from above.
I'm watching from beneath you.
The bottom is my territory.
You swim slower than you walk.
I rise along the riverbed.
Your hands thrash through the water.
I've swung in below you.
The water here is a man deep.
It's already too late.
Weeds have caught your boots.
I follow along the bottom.
The mud you stirred is still drifting.
I'm watching you from below.
Your legs move slowly.
I'm on the other side of the weeds.
The light above is falling further away.
You're swimming for the bank.
I'm faster than the current.
Did the sound of the water change?
I'm an inch from your foot.
Here and now I move.
Your strength is running down.
My horns drive up from below.
I clamp onto your calf.
That came suddenly from the water.
You kicked me away.
I come back around again.
The water's churned white.
Two fresh cuts on your leg.
You can't stand steady in the water.
I turn and rush in again.
This time I've got hold.
I rise up from beneath the surface.
The weeds part as I push through.
My body is completely submerged.
The light on the riverbed is dim.
I slowly line myself up.
Someone is moving up there.
Bubbles rise from my mouth.
This water is neither deep nor shallow.
I travel along the shadow of the bank.
My horns brush through the weeds.
The bottom carries a layer of fine sand.
Along the bottom, I look like a leaf.
Your feet have entered the water.

lines.zh: 水面上的火烧得我发烫。
lines.en: The fire above made the water hot.
I crashed into the water from above.
The water's too shallow to right myself.
The blast heaved the riverbed.

lines.zh: 那股力量在水里跟着我。
lines.en: That force followed me through the water.
Hunger has slowed my swimming.
The current traveled through water to me.
The water fell away beneath me.
